resources.string: Pocket Code can read visible app text and click, type or scroll in the foreground app. With the user's automatic-navigation setting enabled, ordinary navigation may proceed without repeated confirmation. Sensitive or ambiguous clicks still require native confirmation using visible labels and control metadata; this heuristic is not exhaustive. Screenshot capture and every visual tap always require separate approval. Approved screen text and images are sent through 9Router to the configured model. Password nodes and known system/security/financial apps are blocked heuristically, but sensitive content cannot always be detected. Do not use on banking, payment, authentication or other sensitive screens. Disable this service when finished.
